audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Yorick Levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, while whys[1], whys[2], whys[5] and mid all describe those exact stages as Shen's dominant window ('this is your dominant pattern', 'clearly yours').
audit.why: Shen wins 56.94% over 1,642 games and the packet chart reads Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Yorick. Shadow Dash at 2 and Spirit's Refuge at 3 beat a Yorick who has one 20s cage and a swarm of blockable auto-attackers; only his two-item Maiden side-lane flips it.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Yorick in BOTH layers with ratings moved to match. Only the 2+ item stage stays his.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and cooldown line was numberless — 'Dark Procession online', 'level 6', 'first item'.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12 and Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8; against Shen's 18s Shadow Dash that means the cage is available for most of the early game but is a real, trackable 20-second hole at rank 1. Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1 against your 200s Stand United.
audit.corrected: 20s cage and 12s Mourning Mist written into breakdown.cooldowns, whys[3] and dosFull[0].d so 'trade when it is down' has a clock attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said 'Stack Mourning Mist (Q) graves'. Mourning Mist is Yorick's E, not his Q, and it does not dig graves — Last Rites (Q) does. whys[3] repeated the same confusion ('a free Mourning Mist stack').
audit.why: Last Rites (Q, 6s at rank 1) is the bonus-damage auto that heals him and digs a grave on champions; graves feed Shepherd of Souls Mist Walkers. Mourning Mist (E, 12s) is the thrown globule that shreds armour, slows, and marks you so every summoned unit sprints at the mark. Two completely different threats were being described under one wrong name.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] rewritten around Last Rites graves feeding Eulogy of the Isles; whys[3] rewritten around Mourning Mist's armour shred and ghoul-homing mark. Also added the Grievous Wounds interaction: Last Rites is the heal that decides extended trades.

audit.why: packet flagged 'Land Dark Procession' in wants.foe[0] as a suspect name — FALSE POSITIVE, Dark Procession is Yorick's real W and the line is accurate. Left untouched.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dark Procession: 20s at rank 1 — it cages you inside ghoul range, engage once it is spent. - Mourning Mist: 12s, shreds your armour and homes his ghouls onto you. - Shadow Dash: 18s. - Stand United: 200s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. Don’t get caged. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Traps you for ghouls on a 20s cooldown. Engage once it is spent or baited.

edits.before: Dark Procession is the matchup tempo clock at Levels 4-5: track it, trade when it is down, and deny him a free Mourning Mist stack by standing near your minion wave rather than isolated.
edits.after: Dark Procession (20s at rank 1) is the tempo clock at Levels 4-5: trade while the cage is spent, and never eat a free Mourning Mist — it shreds your armour and sends every ghoul sprinting at you.

edits.before: Stack Mourning Mist (Q) graves to maintain a permanent Maiden presence that outraces your W cooldown
edits.after: Dig Last Rites (Q) graves in every trade so his Mist Walkers keep coming faster than Spirit's Refuge cycles

edits.before: Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel tips the attrition heavily in your favour — your tankiness outpaces his ghoul DPS and you can W-block his Maiden's autos in straight trades.
edits.after: Sunfire Aegis plus a Grievous Wounds component tips attrition your way — Last Rites healing stops covering his losses and Spirit's Refuge still blanks the Maiden's autos.

notes: Whether Spirit's Refuge blocks Mist Walker attacks specifically, or whether Dark Procession's wall can block Shadow Dash mid-dash, is NOT in Riot's text — the existing copy asserts the ghoul-blocking, and I left it alone rather than confirm or delete it. The terrain flag on Dark Procession supports 'blocks movement' but not 'cancels a dash in flight', so I wrote neither. Yorick's E carries a 'projectile' flag; the description does describe a thrown globule, so that one looks correct, but I did not write any Wind Wall-class claim since Shen has no such tool.
